Title: Sanjay's Little Adventure

Cast

1. Sanjay - 35 years, prince, son
Look: golden crown, red royal robe
2. Pallavi - 30 years, princess, daughter
Look: small crown, pink lehenga
3. Kavita - 60 years, queen, mother
Look: golden jewellery, green royal dress

Places

1. The training ground - an earth ground, a rack of weapons
2. The forest - tall trees, thick bushes
3. The kitchen - a gas stove, steel pots

Scene 1: The training ground - Day

[Sanjay stands on the training ground. Pallavi and Kavita stand near him.]

Pallavi: "Today feels like a good day."

[Sanjay practises sword fighting.]

Sanjay: "One more time!"

[Sanjay draws his bow and shoots an arrow at the target.]

Sanjay (happily): "One more time!"

[Sanjay mounts his horse and gallops away.]

Pallavi: "Exactly right."

[Sanjay swings his sword from the saddle of his horse.]

Sanjay (surprised): "Oh wow!"

[Sanjay shoots an arrow from his galloping horse.]

Pallavi (happily): "I knew it!"

[Pallavi rides into the training ground on her horse.]

Sanjay (surprised): "And then?"

Scene 2: The forest - Day

[Sanjay stands in the forest. Pallavi stands near him.]

Pallavi: "So, here we are!"

[Sanjay goes hunting and aims his bow at a deer.]

Pallavi: "Let's see."

[Sanjay rides an elephant through the forest.]

Sanjay: "What next?"

Scene 3: The kitchen - Day

[Pallavi stands in the kitchen. Kavita stands near her.]

Kavita: "So, here we are!"

[Pallavi rolls out rotis on the board.]

Kavita (laughing): "Good job, Pallavi!"

[Pallavi stirs the dal in the pot.]

Pallavi: "What a day to remember!"
